name_de: Cube Reaction Hybrid Race 800 Easy Entry
name_en: Cube Reaction Hybrid Race 800 Easy Entry
description_de: Das Cube Reaction Hybrid Race 800 Easy Entry ist ein E-Hardtail-Mountainbike von Cube. Der Antrieb (Bosch Performance Line CX) mit bis zu 120 Nm Drehmoment wird von einem 800-Wh-Akku gespeist. Federung: Fox 34 Float AWL, 2-Position Sweep-Adjust RAIL Damper, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 100mm. Schaltung: Shimano XT RD-M8200-SGS, ShadowPlus, 12-Speed. Bremsen: Shimano XT BR-M8120, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Rahmen: Aluminium Superlite. Erhältlich in den Größen S, M, L, XL.
description_en: The Cube Reaction Hybrid Race 800 Easy Entry is an electric hardtail mountain bike from Cube. The drive (Bosch Performance Line CX) with up to 120 Nm of torque is powered by an 800 Wh battery. Suspension: Fox 34 Float AWL, 2-Position Sweep-Adjust RAIL Damper, Tapered, 15x110mm, E-Bike Optimized, 100mm. Drivetrain: Shimano XT RD-M8200-SGS, ShadowPlus, 12-Speed. Brakes: Shimano XT BR-M8120, Hydr. Disc Brake (203/203). Frame: Aluminium Superlite. Available in sizes S, M, L, XL.
